behavior: deployment-owned context sources freeze kind, scope, trust, refresh, order and byte budgets
task-scoped sources are not read for ordinary conversations without a task identity
step refresh carries the preceding frozen manifest and preserves a complete source version change chain
provider protocol sizing is used when available and conservative frozen-snapshot sizing remains the fallback
result bodies and older complete execution intervals compact into authorized recoverable references without losing user corrections or call/result pairing
non-shrinking compaction tiers are not persisted and unsafe overflow fails closed
stable instructions and tools are fingerprinted separately from dynamic context and actual provider cache usage is reported
current task agreements, received requirement changes and unresolved disagreements are assembled as versioned task data
historical transfers, completion conclusions and compact checkpoints are explicitly historical and do not grant authority
registered sources and stored result references are reauthorized before every model request and historical reuse
revoked historical sources mask derived replies before a later model input is assembled
public diagnostics expose bounded versions, pressure, compaction and cache counts without source content or internal hashes
